profile.summary: My primary goal is taking on projects and assignments that further my professional expertise.  I intend to spend most of my career outside of my comfort zone, increasing my skills and creativity whenever possible.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.locationName: Kansas City, Missouri, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Facilitated the development and growth of a team of engineers.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Kansas City, Missouri, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Developed and supported Big Data healthcare applications using Hadoop and AWS Cloud Tools such as AWS EventBridge, S3, and RDS.
Designed and led development of medium to large scope projects under little direct leadership.
Debugged complex issues spanning multiple interconnected products and complex use cases.
Implemented product enhancements in multiple languages and frameworks.

positions.locationName: Kansas City, Missouri, United States · On-site
positions.description:

Developed comprehensive unit tests using Rspec, JUnit, and Mockito.
